versions.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind
versions.web: Love is patient and is kind.

versions.kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
versions.web: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

versions.kjv: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
versions.web: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

versions.kjv: …a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
versions.web: …a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

versions.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
versions.web: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.

versions.kjv: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
versions.web: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

versions.kjv: I found him whom my soul loveth
versions.web: I found him whom my soul loves.

versions.kjv: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it
versions.web: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it.

items.title: Where you go, I will go

versions.kjv: …whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God
versions.web: …where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

versions.kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
versions.web: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

versions.kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.
versions.web: We love him, because he first loved us.

versions.kjv: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
versions.web: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

items.title: The Lord bless you and keep you

versions.kjv:
The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
versions.web:
Yahweh bless you, and keep you.
Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.

versions.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God
versions.web: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God

versions.kjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment
versions.web: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment

items.title: Unless the Lord builds the house

versions.kjv: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it
versions.web: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain.
